release: TBDub V1.1 Student BF16, two inference steps
revision_policy: Default code SHA, exact HF revisions, file sizes and full SHA256 are locked to the deployed release. A different existing code SHA or model receipt is refused; no automatic migration or checkout replacement. TBDUB_GIT_REF may select a reviewed immutable code SHA explicitly; model manifest remains locked.
storage_policy: Environment, checkpoints, temporary files and caches are under TBDUB_ROOT (default /root/autodl-tmp/tbdub). Exact local_dir file downloads avoid Teacher/full snapshot downloads.
deployment_constraints: Linux/AutoDL CUDA image with working base-image PyTorch, conda, git and NVIDIA driver compatible with CUDA 12.8 wheels; vanilla Ubuntu requires these prerequisites first.
Initial hardware checks require >=24GB VRAM, BF16, >=55GiB effective RAM and >=36GiB free data disk before the TBDub environment. Web/voice/separator environments need additional disk.
Direct Python requirements are pinned; transitive packages are resolved at installation and captured in logs/pip-freeze.txt.
TBDub code and Student checkpoints are Apache-2.0; auxiliary models and dependencies retain their own terms.
Installation scripts check imports, CUDA and downloaded assets; a fresh-machine end-to-end installation has not been rerun as part of repository packaging.
HF_ENDPOINT may be set externally when a trusted mirror is needed; credentials must remain outside this repository.
